decisions.reason: As a 2023-launched handle family that is still listed on the website, it appears to meet at least a minimal aspiration level and would likely be retained while the firm gathers more sales feedback.
The mitred variant is only newly introduced and still presented to the market, so under bounded rationality the firm would more likely keep it for another cycle unless clear underperformance emerges.

Because the multifunctional handle is a more novel offer with somewhat higher uncertainty, management may monitor it closely, but with only one year of market exposure it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
This new door lever handle remains part of the visible assortment, suggesting acceptable early performance relative to aspiration levels and no urgent need for problemistic search.
Its dedicated product page and 2023 German Design Award indicate performance clearly above aspiration and peer comparison, making withdrawal very unlikely.
As a finish option launched in 2023, it likely requires limited additional resources and can be carried with organisational slack while the firm tests customer acceptance.
